recommendations.name: Survey analysis plan
recommendations.description: Prepare scoring, cleaning, and comparison steps for questionnaire responses before data collection starts.
recommendations.rationale: Survey-based evaluations need a predefined analysis plan so the generated results can be interpreted consistently.

recommendations.name: Pilot questionnaire
recommendations.description: Run the questionnaire with a small group to check wording, completion time, and missing response options.
recommendations.rationale: A short pilot reduces ambiguity and improves data quality before the full evaluation.

recommendations.name: Moderation script
recommendations.description: Create a session script with task prompts, neutral follow-up questions, and note-taking checkpoints.
recommendations.rationale: Think-aloud sessions produce more comparable findings when the facilitator follows a consistent protocol.

recommendations.name: Issue coding sheet
recommendations.description: Define a lightweight coding sheet for observed problems, severity, evidence, and affected game element.
recommendations.rationale: Structured coding makes qualitative observations easier to prioritize and report.

recommendations.name: Observation protocol
recommendations.description: Define the behaviors, interaction moments, and contextual notes that observers should capture during sessions.
recommendations.rationale: Observation work needs a shared protocol to avoid inconsistent notes across sessions or observers.

recommendations.name: Sampling and segmentation plan
recommendations.description: Define target segments, minimum sample sizes, and comparison groups before recruiting participants.
recommendations.rationale: Large samples create the opportunity for stronger comparisons, but only if segmentation is planned up front.

recommendations.name: Rapid evaluation checklist
recommendations.description: Limit the evaluation to the highest-risk goals, the fastest instrument, and a short reporting template.
recommendations.rationale: A one-week evaluation window needs strict scope control to remain feasible.

recommendations.name: Research protocol
recommendations.description: Write a short protocol that links objectives, research questions, hypotheses, measures, and analysis decisions.
recommendations.rationale: Research-oriented evaluations need a traceable protocol so conclusions are aligned with the stated questions.

recommendations.name: Ethics and consent review
recommendations.description: Check consent wording, data retention, participant risk, and anonymity before running the evaluation.
recommendations.rationale: Research data collection should make privacy and consent explicit before participants are involved.

recommendations.name: SUS scoring and benchmarking
recommendations.description: Prepare the SUS score conversion, adjective rating interpretation, and benchmark comparison before reporting.
recommendations.rationale: SUS results are most useful when scores are interpreted against established benchmarks.
